node.title: Re^2: Linux::usermod - user name ... already exists
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my $username = `usermod -l $nname $name`; my $dirusername = `usermod -d /home/$nname -m $nname`;

I would recommend against this way of doing this because it allows for injection of arbitrary shell commands via $nname and $name, and it does not check for errors in the commands. [id://1180578|See also].
